name: BRAND TEXT
description:
!brand! infrared sauna parts keep your cabin heating the way it was built to — from carbon or ceramic heaters and control panels to power boards, fuses, relays, and wiring harnesses. We specialize in matching the right Active Forever–compatible replacements so you can fix cold zones, dead touch pads, and power issues without guessing.

Active Forever infrared saunas are known for practical hemlock construction, an in-cabin control panel, and everyday comfort features like reading lights and audio. Heaters typically carry a limited lifetime warranty, with about three years of coverage on other electrics — useful context when you decide whether to repair under warranty or order a direct replacement part.

Browse our Active Forever parts catalog, use Fix/Repair if you already know what failed, or Troubleshoot for a free consult with photos of your model label and the suspect part. Clear model info and a short symptom description get you the correct heater, board, or connector faster — and get your !brand! sauna back to a reliable session.
